attempts.summary: Held curl at its current version (8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8) on node1 via apt-mark hold, verified a simulated upgrade skips curl, then completed the mandatory reboot-evidence protocol on node1: captured baseline boot_id and hold status, triggered a native reboot, confirmed the node went unreachable then came back with a new boot_id, and verified curl's version and hold status persisted post-restart.
